answer: In PoA, each node’s reputation decays with an exponential half-life, so only sustained honest service preserves high trust. EigenTrust factorization, tempered by temporal decay and reciprocity-weighted transitivity, assigns a freshly spawned sybil near-zero eigenvector centrality; lacking trusted incoming mass, it cannot influence or pass consensus. A relic of past behavior cannot be forged: hollow identities may mimic activity, but each honest ember must accumulate verified support over time.
